rows.name: farm
rows.caption: They are leading one of the horses, holding a rope in their hand as they guides it across the grass. This creates a simple outdoor setting with a single person leading a horse. A person wearing a cream-colored garment and a cap is outdoors with 3 brown horses. A fire is burning nearby. The horses is arranged in a line – one on the left, another on the right, and a third positioned centrally between them.
